title: scandosorbus
intro: Scandosorbus, commonly known as Sorbus commixta or Chinese rowan, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. The health benefits of Scandosorbus include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its high content of flavonoids and anthocyanins. The therapeutic actions of Scandosorbus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as quercetin, kaempferol, and isorhapontigenin, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, Scandosorbus has been traditionally used in Eastern medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and digestive issues.
